    ✓ [pin] bare client + failing work-activity: no savepoint is attempted, the write still lands (46 ms)
    ✓ [pin] R1 — a swallow NESTED inside the region poisons the tx anyway; RELEASE fails and says so (23 ms)
    ✓ [pin] bare client, happy path: the activity is created, still no savepoint (18 ms)
